Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Host BAR 777 and other mini games with automated queue management.
Description: A plugin to manage mini game sessions, player queues, and Gil transactions. Use /minigames to open the main window.
Changelog:
**Beta Release v0.0.0.1**
- BAR 777: pay entry fee, roll /random to hit the winning number within allotted rolls
- Walk-in and Queue modes
- Configurable queue keyword with per-channel toggles (say, shout, yell, tell)
- Persistent queue across restarts
- Trade verification and Boosted Pot support
- Live roll tracking and automatic win detection
- Six customisable chat templates with auto-send toggles
- Rate-limited outbound chat queue
- Statistics panel and Transaction History ledger
- Neon nightclub UI theme with per-game accent colours
- Commands: /mge, /minigamesemporium, /mgeconfig
